mutation Mutation($payload: [WorkOrderProcessBomCreatePayloadInput!]!) {
  createWorkOrderProcessBom(payload: $payload) {

    fixedMaterialUsage
    laborUsage
    machineUsage
    maximumUsage
    minimumUsage
    rate
    standardPackQuantity

    unitPerCycle
    active
    defaultPackaging
    externalId
    reference
    customData
    integrationData
    bomTypeId

    assemblyProductStrategyProcessId
    assetId
    componentPackagingMaterialId
    componentProductId
    componentProductStrategyId
    componentProductStrategyProcessId
    consumptionModeId
    productStrategyProcessBomId
  }
}
